q: Priest Ya’qob held a small metal gong called the qachel in one hand and the small metal stick with which it was struck in the other.

The non-Jewish Ethiopian qachel differs from Beta Israel instruments. It is a small bell used for both religious and secular music of the orthodox Ethiopian Christian.

The melodies may be pentatonic or based on intervals of a third, and may be accompanied by a small drum called nagarīt and a gong called qachel.
